result:
These queries come from the page alone and none were run, so some rest on guesses:
- **Modifiers I assumed:** `round 2`, `groupBy ~(…)` and `indexBy ~(…)` taking a key quote, and `reduce #[] ~(union)`.
- **No `trim` verb:** the page lists none, so L9 and L10 remove spaces with `split " " | join ""`. That is safe only because no name or version contains an inner space.
- **L6:** the average is 76.25 and the final rounding step may land on either side.

L1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * /items | flat * (mul /qty (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum | round 2
L2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | groupBy * count
L3: [(/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys) (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | keys)] | reduce #[] ~(union) * keyword | sort
L4: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) * (/email | lower) | distinct | sort
L5: /services | :s / | keys * {:name keyword :svc (s | at /)} | filter ~(/svc | at :enabled | coalesce true) | filter ~(/svc/port | ne null) * {:name /name :port /svc/port} | sort ~/port
L6: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | filter ~(/3 | eq "200") * (/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | :d / | sum | div (d | count) | round 1
L7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (/ * (/2 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round 0)
L8: groupBy ~(/user) * count | :c / | keys * {:u keyword :n (c | at /)} | sort ~([(/n | mul -1) /u]) | take 3 * (:r / | /u | append ":" | append (r | /n | print))
L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split " " | join "" | split "," * lower | distinct | sort | join "|"
L10: lines * (split " " | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * split "==" | indexBy ~(/0 | lower) * /1
L11: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /number]) | take 2 * /number
L12: groupBy ~(/customer) | filter ~(count | gte 2) | keys * keyword | sort
L13: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * (/ * /name | sort)
L14: filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :repo | coalesce {} | at :name | ne null) * /payload/repo/name | distinct | sort
